home.heroSubtitle: Handcrafted silver, semi-precious gems, and pearl pieces — each made with intention and quality-curated in Zürich.
home.founderText: Kalakosh Zürich is a brand of Atelier by Arora, with roots deeply embedded in India's jewellery heritage. Every piece is the work of master artisans from Rajasthan — silversmiths, stone-setters, and pearl-stringers whose families have practised their craft for centuries — brought to Zürich to be worn and cherished.

about.title: About Kalakosh Zurich
about.story1: Kalakosh Zürich is a brand of Atelier by Arora. Born from a love of Indian craft and a desire to share it with the world, Kalakosh takes its name — meaning treasury of art — from a deep respect for the traditions it carries.
about.story2: Every piece in our collection is the work of master artisans from Rajasthan — craftspeople whose families have shaped silver, set precious stones, and strung pearls for centuries. Their knowledge passes from hand to hand across generations, and it shows in every piece.
about.story3: With roots in Kalakosh India, our founding house in Delhi, and a home in Zürich, we are the bridge between ancient craft and a modern life well lived.
about.ctaSubtitle: Discover pieces made to be worn and remembered.
